article.headline: Phoenix hosts Golden State in conference showdown
article.description: Golden State Warriors (0-2, 14th in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (0-1, 11th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Phoenix hosts Golden State in conference showdown
article.linkText: Phoenix hosts Golden State in conference showdown
article.story: Golden State Warriors (0-2, 14th in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (0-1, 11th in the Western Conference) Phoenix; Saturday, 10 p.m. EDT LINE: Suns -9.5; over/under is 224.5 BOTTOM LINE: Phoenix hosts Golden State in a matchup of Western Conference teams. Phoenix finished 45-37 overall, 10-7 in Pacific Division games and 25-16 at home last season. The Suns gave up 111.1 points per game while committing 20.6 fouls last season. Golden State finished 37-45 overall, 7-9 in Pacific Division play and 15-26 on the road last season. The Warriors averaged 28.9 assists per game on 40.9 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Suns: Oso Ighodaro: day to day (hip), Mark Williams: out (shoulder), Luke Kennard: day to day (knee). Warriors: Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Charles Bassey: day to day (patellar), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
